Although dealing with hard, heavy logs can be tiring work, a reputation for quality craftsmanship is sure to spread, and people are sure to seek you out. The Carpentry skill must be used at a Carpentry Workbench, found at the Logging Camp and elsewhere. | ## Details [![](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/images/a/ae/CarpentryWoodworking.png)](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/File:CarpentryWoodworking.png) [Enlarge](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/File:CarpentryWoodworking.png "Enlarge") The woodworking part of carpentry - Carpentry is a form of production that utilizes [Firewood](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Firewood "Firewood") to produce wooden weapons. - Please see the [Carpentry List](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Carpentry_List "Carpentry List") for a list of possible items that can be produced by Carpentry and for success rates. - Carpentry requires a [Lumber Axe](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Lumber_Axe "Lumber Axe") for [chopping wood](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Chopping_Block "Chopping Block") or a [Woodworking Plane](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Woodworking_Plane "Woodworking Plane") for [shaping and fashioning wood](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Carpentry_Workbench "Carpentry Workbench"). Both tools can be purchased from [Tracy](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Tracy "Tracy"). - [Dugald Aisle](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Dugald_Aisle "Dugald Aisle") is the only location where both forms of Carpentry can be performed. [Chopping Blocks](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Chopping_Block_(Homestead) "Chopping Block (Homestead)") and Carpentry Workbenches can be placed in a [Homestead](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Homestead "Homestead"). Carpentry Workbenches can also be found in [Emain Macha](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Emain_Macha "Emain Macha"). - Like [Potion Making](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Potion_Making "Potion Making"), [Blacksmithing](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Blacksmithing "Blacksmithing") and [Tailoring](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Tailoring "Tailoring"), [Dexterity](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Dexterity "Dexterity") has no influence on Carpentry. - The rate of successfully chopping wood is `40% + Carpentry Rank Bonus + Production Mastery Bonus.` - Upon success, there is a: - 82% chance of receiving normal [Firewood](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Firewood "Firewood"). - 15% chance of receiving [Average Firewood](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Average_Firewood "Average Firewood"). - 3% chance of receiving [Fine Firewood](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Fine_Firewood "Fine Firewood"). - Higher grades of firewood produced by Carpentry amplify the effects of the following: - [Campfire](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Campfire "Campfire") regeneration rate. - [Enchant](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Enchant "Enchant") burning success rate. - _**Reduced**_ [refining](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Refining "Refining") success rate at [Vales](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Vales "Vales")'s [Old Furnaces](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Old_Furnace_(Public) "Old Furnace (Public)"). - When crafting a bow, the game will tell you the stat bonuses and a message regarding the quality. - i.e. "Your creation is far superior to anything you can get from a store.", "Your efforts created an above-average `item`!", "Your hard work produced a very nice `item`!" ### [Carpentry Quality](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Item_Quality\#Blacksmith.2C_Carpentry.2C_and_Tailoring "Item Quality") - Weapons and Equipment crafted with the Blacksmith, Carpentry, or Tailoring Skills will receive an Item Quality that correlates to additional stats the items can receive. - For Blacksmith and Tailoring, the game determines the base Quality depending on how well you did in the Skill minigame. - For Carpentry, the game determines the base Quality randomly based on the Carpentry Skill Rank. - The Quality then has various possible bonuses added to it. - Crafting on [Monday](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Monday "Monday") will provide an additional +3 Production Quality. - Using certain Titles (i.e. the [the Master of Carpentry](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/index.php?title=The_Master_of_Carpentry&action=edit&redlink=1 "The Master of Carpentry (page does not exist)") 1st Title and the [who is Known Far and Wide as 2nd Title](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Who_is_Known_Far_and_Wide_as_2nd_Title "Who is Known Far and Wide as 2nd Title"); the [Edern 2nd Title](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Edern_2nd_Title "Edern 2nd Title"), [Crazy Crafter 2nd Title](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Crazy_Crafter_2nd_Title "Crazy Crafter 2nd Title"), or [Special Luminous Cosmic Milky Way 2nd Title](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Special_Luminous_Cosmic_Milky_Way_2nd_Title "Special Luminous Cosmic Milky Way 2nd Title")) can increase Quality. - Using items Enchanted with [Product Quality Modifiers](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Product_Quality_Modifiers "Product Quality Modifiers") (i.e. [Steady](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Steady "Steady") or [Daunting](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Daunting "Daunting")) can increase Quality. - Using [Reforges](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Reforges "Reforges") (i.e. those for [Tailoring Kits](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Tailoring_Kit "Tailoring Kit"), Accessories, or [Woodworking Planes](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Woodworking_Plane "Woodworking Plane")) can increase Quality. - Using a respective [Production Quality Potion](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Category:Production_Quality_Potions "Category:Production Quality Potions") can increase Quality. - [Player](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Player "Player")-crafted items will receive a Crafter's Signature _**if Quality is 80 or higher**_. - Blacksmith and Tailoring require the Skill Rank to be Rank 9 or higher. - The Crafter's Signature will show the name of the Character as well as their Skill Rank. - Set Effect rolls will not count towards a Crafter's Signature; some items will receive a bonus Set Effect point if Quality is high. - Some [Erg Sacrifice Items](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Erg_Sacrifice_Items "Erg Sacrifice Items") require Signed items crafted with Blacksmith or Tailoring. | \[show\]Item Quality Additional Stats by Item Type

Description

 A skill that allows one to process high-quality firewood and craft bows. Although dealing with hard, heavy logs can be tiring work, a reputation for quality craftsmanship is sure to spread, and people are sure to seek you out. The Carpentry skill must be used at a Carpentry Workbench, found at the Logging Camp and elsewhere.

Details

The woodworking part of carpentry
  • Carpentry is a form of production that utilizes Firewood to produce wooden weapons.
    • Please see the Carpentry List for a list of possible items that can be produced by Carpentry and for success rates.
  • Carpentry requires a Lumber Axe for chopping wood or a Woodworking Plane for shaping and fashioning wood. Both tools can be purchased from Tracy.
  • Dugald Aisle is the only location where both forms of Carpentry can be performed. Chopping Blocks and Carpentry Workbenches can be placed in a Homestead. Carpentry Workbenches can also be found in Emain Macha.
  • Like Potion Making, Blacksmithing and Tailoring, Dexterity has no influence on Carpentry.
  • The rate of successfully chopping wood is 40% + Carpentry Rank Bonus + Production Mastery Bonus.
    • Upon success, there is a:
      • 82% chance of receiving normal Firewood.
      • 15% chance of receiving Average Firewood.
      • 3% chance of receiving Fine Firewood.
  • Higher grades of firewood produced by Carpentry amplify the effects of the following:
    • Campfire regeneration rate.
    • Enchant burning success rate.
    • Reduced refining success rate at Vales's Old Furnaces.
  • When crafting a bow, the game will tell you the stat bonuses and a message regarding the quality.
    • i.e. "Your creation is far superior to anything you can get from a store.", "Your efforts created an above-average item!", "Your hard work produced a very nice item!"

Carpentry Quality

  • Weapons and Equipment crafted with the Blacksmith, Carpentry, or Tailoring Skills will receive an Item Quality that correlates to additional stats the items can receive.
    • For Blacksmith and Tailoring, the game determines the base Quality depending on how well you did in the Skill minigame.
    • For Carpentry, the game determines the base Quality randomly based on the Carpentry Skill Rank.
    • The Quality then has various possible bonuses added to it.
      • Crafting on Monday will provide an additional +3 Production Quality.
      • Using certain Titles (i.e. the the Master of Carpentry 1st Title and the who is Known Far and Wide as 2nd Title; the Edern 2nd Title, Crazy Crafter 2nd Title, or Special Luminous Cosmic Milky Way 2nd Title) can increase Quality.
      • Using items Enchanted with Product Quality Modifiers (i.e. Steady or Daunting) can increase Quality.
      • Using Reforges (i.e. those for Tailoring Kits, Accessories, or Woodworking Planes) can increase Quality.
      • Using a respective Production Quality Potion can increase Quality.
  • Player-crafted items will receive a Crafter's Signature if Quality is 80 or higher.
    • Blacksmith and Tailoring require the Skill Rank to be Rank 9 or higher.
    • The Crafter's Signature will show the name of the Character as well as their Skill Rank.
    • Set Effect rolls will not count towards a Crafter's Signature; some items will receive a bonus Set Effect point if Quality is high.
  • Some Erg Sacrifice Items require Signed items crafted with Blacksmith or Tailoring.

Obtaining the Skill

Complete the The Basics of Carpentry quest.

Or,

Talk to Tracy in Dugald Aisle using the Skills Keyword to start the quest.

How to Get Quest

Talk to Tracy using the Skills keyword.

Briefing Have you heard about the new fad in the logging industry called Carpentry? Try purchasing a Lumber Axe that I sell and use it to obtain 1 Average Firewood. -Tracy
Objectives
  • Purchase a Lumber Axe and equip it.
    • Purchasing one is not actually necessary, only equipping.
  • Gather one Average Firewood.
  • Deliver the Average Firewood to Tracy.
Rewards
  • 5000 Experience Points
  • 1000 Gold
  • Carpentry skill

Training Method

  • Gathering wood from a tree with a Gathering Axe will count towards the "Chop wood to gather Firewood" training method.
  • Starting from Rank 8, training requirements include making bows that require Leather Straps, Thin Thread Ball or Thick Thread Ball, created by Weaving. From Rank 6 and beyond, creation of these bows is needed to advance into further ranks.
  • The "Make a high-quality Bow" training method starting from Rank 4 is completed when crafting a bow and receiving a message that describes your creation as "godly". The resulting bow will receive a Crafter's Signature.
